function.name: checkCalendar
function.description: Returns the next 2 available appointment slots for the requested service type. Use this for standard (non-emergency) booking requests.

service_type.description: The type of service being booked (e.g. 'plumbing-routine', 'legal-consultation', 'med-spa-botox', 'property-maintenance').

requested_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD) if the caller requested a specific date. Omit to return the next available slots.

duration_minutes.description: Estimated appointment duration in minutes. Defaults to 60 if not specified.
